sentence_stem: Since the text deliberately resists a single interpretation,
correct_completion: readers must construct their own reading.
full_sentence: Since the text deliberately resists a single interpretation, readers must construct their own reading.
acceptable_variants: readers cannot rely on one authoritative meaning.
each reader becomes partly responsible for the meaning.

options.text: the author's intention is therefore obvious.
options.why_wrong: This contradicts the stem, which says the text resists a single meaning, so the intention cannot be obvious.

options.why_wrong: This adds a fact about publication, but 'since' requires a logical consequence of the stated reason.

options.text: every critic agrees on its meaning.
options.why_wrong: This contradicts the stem, because a text that resists interpretation cannot have a single agreed meaning.

explanation: After 'since', the main clause must state a logical consequence of the reason given, here the need for readers to build their own interpretation.
